# MMLAW Law Firm (mmlaw.ge)

> MMLAW is a criminal defence law firm in Georgia (office in Tbilisi) with more than 10 years of practice. Criminal law is its main practice: it defends suspects, accused persons and witnesses at every stage — arrest, questioning, search, preventive measures, trial and appeals up to the Supreme Court — including drug offences, cybercrime and juvenile cases. The firm also handles civil, administrative, labour, corporate, real estate, family, inheritance and intellectual property matters. Consultations in Georgian, English and Russian; the first consultation is free. Formerly at lfs.ge.

- Phone / WhatsApp: +995 551 00 43 00
- Email: info@mmlaw.ge
- Office: Tbilisi, Georgia. Hours: Monday–Friday, 10:00–18:00
- Languages: Georgian (default, https://mmlaw.ge/ka/), English (https://mmlaw.ge/en/), Russian (https://mmlaw.ge/ru/)

## Practice areas

- [Criminal defense](https://mmlaw.ge/en/criminal-defense-lawyer/): MMLAW criminal defense lawyers represent suspects, accused persons, witnesses and victims at every stage of a criminal case in Georgia — from the first questioning all the way through the Supreme Court.
- [Drug offences](https://mmlaw.ge/en/drug-crime-lawyer/): Drug crime lawyer in Georgia: we defend persons suspected or accused of drug offences, and witnesses, in criminal and administrative cases — from the first minute of an arrest or search.
- [Cybercrime](https://mmlaw.ge/en/cybercrime-lawyer/): We defend accused persons and witnesses in cybercrime cases in Georgia and help victims of online fraud, account hacking, blackmail and other digital harm.
- [Property crimes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/property-crime-lawyer/): Property crime lawyer in Georgia: we defend suspects, accused persons and witnesses in cases of theft, robbery, fraud, extortion, embezzlement and misappropriation.
- [Economic crimes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/economic-crime-lawyer/): Economic crime lawyer in Georgia: we defend company directors, business owners and individuals against tax evasion, money laundering, customs violations and other economic charges.
- [Corruption and official crimes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/corruption-crime-lawyer/): Corruption crime lawyer in Georgia: we defend public officials, business owners and individuals in cases of bribery, trading in influence and abuse or excess of official power.
- [Violent crimes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/violent-crime-lawyer/): Violent crime lawyer in Georgia: we defend suspects, accused persons and witnesses in cases of bodily injury, violence, threats and homicide, and we help victims.
- [Juvenile justice](https://mmlaw.ge/en/juvenile-justice-lawyer/): We defend children and young people in criminal and related proceedings under Georgia's Juvenile Justice Code, with a focus on rehabilitation and the child's best interests.
- [Civil litigation](https://mmlaw.ge/en/civil-litigation-lawyer/): We represent individuals and companies in civil disputes in Georgia — from pre-trial negotiation through all three court instances.
- [Administrative law](https://mmlaw.ge/en/administrative-law-lawyer/): We help individuals and businesses challenge unlawful decisions of public authorities and navigate licensing, permit and regulatory procedures in Georgia.
- [Labor disputes](https://mmlaw.ge/en/employment-lawyer/): We represent employees and employers in labour disputes under the Labour Code of Georgia — from unlawful dismissal to drafting contracts and workplace policies.
- [Corporate law](https://mmlaw.ge/en/corporate-lawyer/): Strategic legal support for businesses in Georgia — from company registration to mergers and acquisitions, compliance and restructuring.
- [Real estate](https://mmlaw.ge/en/real-estate-lawyer/): Full legal support for real estate in Georgia — checking the property, structuring and signing the deal, registering ownership and resolving disputes.
- [Family law](https://mmlaw.ge/en/family-lawyer/): Discreet, professional representation in divorce, child residence, alimony and division of marital property in Georgia.
- [Inheritance](https://mmlaw.ge/en/inheritance-lawyer/): We help you accept an inheritance in Georgia, obtain the certificate of inheritance and register the property in your name — and represent you in disputes between heirs.
- [Intellectual property](https://mmlaw.ge/en/intellectual-property-lawyer/): We protect brands, creative works and inventions — from registration with Sakpatenti to disputes with infringers.

## For foreigners in Georgia

- [Legal help for foreigners](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/): Moving to Georgia, buying property, starting a business or facing a legal problem here? We advise foreigners in English and Russian — at our Tbilisi office or remotely.
- [Buying property in Georgia as a foreigner](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/buying-property-in-georgia/): Foreigners can buy apartments, houses and non-agricultural land in Georgia on the same terms as Georgians. We check the property, prepare the contract and register your ownership — even if you are abroad.
- [Company registration in Georgia for foreigners](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/company-registration-in-georgia/): Foreigners can own 100% of a Georgian company and run it from abroad. We register LLCs, branches and individual entrepreneurs, prepare corporate documents and support you with banks, contracts and tax registration.
- [Residence permit in Georgia — lawyer for foreigners](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/residence-permit-in-georgia/): We prepare and file residence permit applications for foreigners in Georgia, follow them through the Public Service Hall and appeal refusals.
- [Criminal defense lawyer for foreigners](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/criminal-defense-for-foreigners/): When a foreigner faces a criminal case in Georgia, language and unfamiliar procedure are the first obstacles. We defend you in English or Russian — from the moment of arrest to trial.
- [Family lawyer for foreigners in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/foreigners/family-law-for-foreigners/): Family cases with an international element follow their own rules. We help with divorce, child residence and alimony, and the recognition of foreign court decisions — in English or Russian.

## For Georgians living abroad

- [Legal help for Georgians living abroad](https://mmlaw.ge/en/georgians-abroad/): We handle your matter in Georgia without you having to travel — by power of attorney, remote consultations and constant contact on WhatsApp.

## Articles

- [Fraud charges in Georgia: penalties and your defence](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/fraud-charges-in-georgia/): Fraud charges in Georgia: what counts as fraud, how the penalty depends on the amount of damage, and what to do if you are accused.
- [Theft charges in Georgia: penalties and your rights](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/theft-charges-in-georgia/): Theft charges in Georgia: how the value of property, breaking into a home and acting as a group affect the penalty, and what to do if accused.
- [Domestic violence charges in Georgia: what to know](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/domestic-violence-charges-georgia/): Domestic violence under Georgian law: who counts as a family member, the penalties, what makes a charge more serious, and what to do as accused or victim.
- [Drunk driving in Georgia: fines, licence, prison](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/drunk-driving-in-georgia/): Drunk driving rules in Georgia: alcohol limits, licence suspension, refusing a test, and when it becomes a criminal offence.
- [Bail or pre-trial detention in Georgia: how courts decide](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/bail-and-pretrial-detention-georgia/): How a Georgian court decides whether an accused stays in custody: types of preventive measures, bail, the detention limit and the 48-hour appeal.
- [Plea agreements in Georgia: when they're worth it](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/plea-agreement-in-georgia/): Plea agreements in Georgia: how they are made between the prosecution and the accused, what you gain, what you give up and what the court checks.
- [Arrested for drugs in Georgia: what to do](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/arrested-for-drugs-in-georgia/): What to do if you are arrested over drugs in Georgia: your rights, the search, drug testing, deadlines, possible penalties and mistakes to avoid.
- [Marijuana law in Georgia: what gets you fined?](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/marijuana-law-in-georgia/): The rules on marijuana in Georgia: small amounts, using it in public places, minors, and when it becomes a criminal offence.
- [Unfairly dismissed in Georgia? What to do](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/unlawful-dismissal-georgia/): What to do if you were unfairly dismissed in Georgia: asking for written grounds, documents, deadlines and what you can claim in court.
- [Accepting an inheritance in Georgia from abroad](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/inheritance-from-abroad/): How to accept an inheritance in Georgia while living abroad: the 6-month deadline, power of attorney, documents and what happens if you missed the deadline.
- [Scammed online? How to try to get your money back](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/online-fraud-what-to-do/): What to do if you were scammed online in Georgia: your bank, evidence, reporting to the police — and the "money recovery" scammers.
- [How to appeal a fine in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/how-to-appeal-a-fine/): If you think a fine is unfair: where and how to appeal it in Georgia, what evidence to gather and which mistakes to avoid.
- [Buying an apartment in Georgia: what to check](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/buying-an-apartment-checklist/): What to check before buying an apartment in Georgia: the Public Registry extract, the seller, spouse consent, new builds and outstanding debts.
- [Registering an LLC in Georgia: what you need](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/how-to-register-llc-in-georgia/): How to register an LLC in Georgia: documents, legal address, charter, timing and what to do after registration — including for foreigners.
- [Residence permits in Georgia: which type do you need?](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/residence-permit-types-georgia/): The main types of residence permit in Georgia — work, business, property, family, study and investment — and how to choose the right one.
- [Police search in Georgia: your rights and what to do](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/police-search-your-rights/): What to know if your home or office is searched in Georgia: the court order, your lawyer, the search record and mistakes to avoid.
- [Child support (alimony) in Georgia: how the amount is set](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/alimony-in-georgia/): Who pays alimony in Georgia, how the amount is determined, how it can be changed and what happens if it isn't paid.
- [Detained in Georgia? Your rights and what to do](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/what-to-do-if-detained/): Your key rights if you are arrested in Georgia: the right to remain silent, to a lawyer, to an interpreter and to inform a relative — and the 48/72-hour rule.
- [Divorce in Georgia: civil registry or court?](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/divorce-in-georgia/): When you can divorce at the Public Service Hall and when only a court can decide — plus children, alimony and division of property in Georgia.
- [Who is a judge? Courts and judges in Georgia](https://mmlaw.ge/en/blog/who-is-a-judge-in-georgia/): A judge is a person vested with the authority to hear and decide cases in court. How the court system in Georgia is organised and who can become a judge.
